public_code.author_official_status: not established; public repository self-identifies as RLRC and references author Transformers fork
confirmed_mismatches: Paper uses RLinf; public RL script uses SimplerEnv train_ms3_ppo for ManiSkill.
Paper main pruning target is 90%; public prune.sh specifies 0.95.
Paper Taylor importance uses robotic demonstrations; public hf_prune.py uses BookCorpus language-model loss.
Public SFT script uses rank32, batch8, 4 GPU processes; current experiments use rank8, batch4, one A100.
Public install pins torch2.2, Python3.10 and modified Transformers; current LeRobot environment is Python3.12/torch2.7.1.
Public prune.sh contains shell assignments with spaces; it is not ready to run unchanged.
